verdict.rationale: Flagsmith ships a CLI that can manage flags and evaluate flags from the terminal (like an SDK), a full Admin/Management API for programmatic control, and self-hostable Docker deployments plus an Edge Proxy for running the engine in your own infra—together enabling headless/CI usage. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) and independent/community verification of CLI or API use in automated pipelines.
